title: God Makes All Things New
summary: God Makes All Things New follows a real Bible moment about hope. God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. When sadness and brokenness feel permanent, this hope tells kids that God's final future is healing, nearness, and joy.

read_it.prompt: Read Revelation 21:1-5 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: John saw a new heaven and new earth. God promised to make all things new and remove death, mourning, crying, and pain. Kids can retell it by naming what happened, who responded, and what God showed.
understand_it: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. God Makes All Things New also shows that hope has a shape in real life, not only in Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: Revelation shows God making all things new.
age_8_11_explanation: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. The lesson helps older kids compare the story's wise path with the easier path people may have wanted.
teen_explanation: When sadness and brokenness feel permanent, this hope tells kids that God's final future is healing, nearness, and joy. God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. The story leaves room to talk about courage, humility, repentance, or hope without pretending the hard part is small.
key_truths: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.
God Makes All Things New shows hope through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When sadness and brokenness feel permanent, this hope tells kids that God's final future is healing, nearness, and joy.
life_application: When sadness and brokenness feel permanent, this hope tells kids that God's final future is healing, nearness, and joy.

quiz_questions.question: What does God promise to make new?
choices: People fix the world without God
The city has no light because it is empty
quiz_questions.explanation: This answer keeps the focus where the Bible puts it: All things. God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.

quiz_questions.question: God Makes All Things New is mainly about hope without ignoring the actual Bible story.
quiz_questions.explanation: The theme matters because it grows out of Revelation 21:1-5, not from a random moral pasted onto the end.

memory_verse.prompt: Practice Revelation 21:5 and listen for how it supports the lesson's hope theme.

discussion_questions: What surprised you in God Makes All Things New?
Why does hope matter in God Makes All Things New?
What would change if someone actually lived out the hope lesson in God Makes All Things New?

activity.title: New Creation Window
activity.instructions: Draw a window looking into Revelation's promise, then add no more tears and God with His people.

prayer_prompt: Jesus, help me remember the truth in God Makes All Things New and live it with people around me.
